subject: build_tenants/common/
standalone_boundary: All construction history and prior-work accounting stays outside common; operative method meanings and current dependencies are local to the candidate. Generic revision and evidence-reuse law is retained.

items.title: Unauthorized mutation remains an effect
items.agreed_scope: Tighten refused_effect evidence to establish that no mutation began within the material effect boundary. Preserve actual or uncertain unauthorized effects under the existing effect/recovery law.
items.scope_limits: Base not_effected concerns failure to attain the intended outcome, not universal absence of effects. Do not claim the existing core generally permits repetition. Change the profile evidence condition; keep three effect values.
items.discriminating_case: A refusal is lawful but an unauthorized mutation occurred or remains possible: refusal cannot establish mutation absence.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: UX carries unresolved command outcomes
items.agreed_scope: Require a typed outcome family representing every materially possible observed or unresolved effect case, with correlation, recovery and replay coverage, using base effect predicates.
items.scope_limits: A lost/failed transport response alone does not decide completion; other sufficient observations may already decide it. Base success/failure fields do not forbid richer messages. M1 and M2 consume the same generic owner and are not circular prerequisites.
items.discriminating_case: Replay of completion_unknown can pass while external completion remains unresolved; observe the owning state before dependent repetition.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Qualify the blanket reuse prohibition
items.agreed_scope: Anti-pattern 11 prohibits inherited reliance after a change without an established applicability relation, not all reuse of a predecessor verdict.
items.scope_limits: Our original family-level review missed this exact contradicting consumer sentence. Preserve the existing generic reuse owners.
items.discriminating_case: An unrelated change leaves old arithmetic evidence applicable while a changed fixture invalidates another test.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Event log only when the binding requires one
items.agreed_scope: Record the admitted execution basis on the selected durable work carrier, including an event log where the execution binding requires it.
items.scope_limits: Preserve durable evidence and result requirements; environment neutrality does not waive adopted software/event obligations.
items.discriminating_case: Human execution uses a signed register without an event stream; a software binding that requires events still acquires them.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Calculus acknowledges imported result owners
items.agreed_scope: Replace the sole-normative-authority sentence with calculus specialization ownership plus explicit consumption of FOUNDATIONS result and conjunction law.
items.scope_limits: The actual calculus laws already consume those owners. This reconciles the head ownership claim; it creates no new result owner or Judgment record. Track any affected predecessor exclusive-ownership claim separately.
items.discriminating_case: AC-007 and AC-019 resolve to the same core owners before and after the wording repair.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Map the material repricing decision
items.agreed_scope: Preserve retained/superseded/deferred/withdrawn as obligation states. Separately define the material authorized decision establishing that disposition, its exact predicate and domain refinement into the core.
items.scope_limits: TICKETS owns this repricing refinement; it must not reuse ACTIVATION candidate-acceptance as the predicate. The current blanket exemption from the core is inadequate. Our earlier F13 retain decision missed that defect.
items.discriminating_case: A lawful deferral decision can be established while delivery remains failed or outstanding. An unauthorized withdrawn label cannot close an obligation.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Route design diagnosis to the actual owner
items.agreed_scope: Keep the 56 review questions. An unanswered required relation withholds its conformance claim; diagnosis follows evidence to the relevant owner.
items.scope_limits: Our earlier F17 no-proven-gain conclusion missed the categorical coupling/imperative diagnosis at the end of the review questions.
items.discriminating_case: Missing authority or observation cannot establish excessive coupling or imperative design.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Clarify reuse pointers and RF-005
items.agreed_scope: Explain that RF-005 addresses evaluation on the wrong required basis, and route reuse/current reliance to the existing applicability owners. Add those pointers to the Executive sentences.
items.scope_limits: Replace basis advance alone invalidates nothing with: advancement does not rewrite the historical result; reliance on the new subject/basis requires established applicability, and affected reliance is withdrawn until established. Scope clarification is defensible; do not automatically count three new semantic replacements.
items.discriminating_case: Preserve historical result while invalidating reliance affected by a changed fixture, basis coordinate or capability.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Defect reporter versus repair author
items.agreed_scope: Reporting a defect/counterexample or already-required behavior does not itself author the realized subject. Contributing adopted wording, policy or design does.
items.scope_limits: Qualify may assess the repair by the existing authority, authorship and evidence-independence conditions. Reporting required behavior must not be equated with authoring/directing a particular repair.
items.discriminating_case: A reporter rechecks a failure case; an author of adopted replacement wording needs another assessor for that contribution.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Keep intake classification unresolved when necessary
items.agreed_scope: Procedure enters universal intake triage and keeps classification open until evidence supports a lawful class.
items.scope_limits: The actual triage owner already supplies this behavior. Correct donor citation is SPEC_METHOD 3433-3444, especially 3435-3441.
items.discriminating_case: An incomplete report enters triage without inventing a lawful change classification.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Evidence reuse route and bounded acquisition
items.agreed_scope: Provide ordinary task entry to the existing evidence-reuse owners and adequate bounded acquisition for that task.
items.scope_limits: Choose a new frame, an extension, or direct subsection acquisition from task evidence. Claude itself offers the smaller stale-summary extension; do not prescribe an estimated 75-90 KB new frame before measuring need.
items.discriminating_case: Fresh actor performs change-impact/reuse task without private context; record acquisition and preserved distinctions.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Task rows stop at the deciding subsection
items.agreed_scope: Add direct subsection routes for lawful work versus outcome, meaning of a test result, and core values/conjunction. Mark family tables as traces.
items.scope_limits: Exact anchoring does not waive acquisition of material coupled owners.
items.discriminating_case: Outcome/test/conjunction tasks reach the actual deciding clause without a full unrelated section read.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Show available frames alongside routes
items.agreed_scope: Link an applicable existing frame when one serves the task; repair the two omitted existing frames.
items.scope_limits: A route without a suitable frame may name direct owning sections. A frame column must not force a new frame for every route.
items.discriminating_case: Acceptance-release and member-build-assess are discoverable; a direct-owner route remains lawful.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Intake, ambiguity and carrier acquisition
items.agreed_scope: Cover intake, ambiguity, carrier selection and test-case authority through a useful bounded entry.
items.scope_limits: Treat an 80-95 KB intake-triage frame as one candidate. Compare precise owner routes and smaller compositions on the same S1/S4/S6 tasks. Being below 160 KB alone is not qualification.
items.discriminating_case: Actors preserve unresolved classification and test-case authority with less needless acquisition under matched conditions.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Deciding head paragraphs before trace tables
items.agreed_scope: Add short routing heads before the F22/F2/F11/F13 tables, pointing to deciding subsections.
items.scope_limits: These heads locate law, not summarize a second normative rule. Regenerate affected selected excerpts and digests.
items.discriminating_case: A reader reaches the requested owner without treating its derivation table as an operative answer.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Six-condition admissibility route
items.agreed_scope: Consider an additional route to existing admissibility owners only if a concrete task still benefits after R2/R5.
items.scope_limits: Claude reports no fixed trace for this row. Do not introduce TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY, a second owner or a mandatory six-check workflow. Not part of the unconditional baseline loan set.
items.discriminating_case: A matched admission task gains reliable distinctions or lower acquisition without extra reconciliation.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Complete reviewed-package identity
items.agreed_scope: Freeze the actual new reviewed baseline package and compare complete membership plus every member byte/digest, with exact declared coordinate exceptions.
items.scope_limits: Adapt the behavior to the successor. The donor RC9 label-only whitelist is specific to its relabeling, not a ban on the selected semantic changes.
items.discriminating_case: Unchanged package passes; altered, extra, missing or duplicate member fails.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Construction-metadata hygiene
items.agreed_scope: Remove stale status and reject forbidden construction metadata under the selected publication policy.
items.scope_limits: Do not blanket-ban every Author/Status/Date/Revision or generated_at occurrence across templates, examples and domain records. Donor regex is package-specific with attribution rules; adapt a scoped check.
items.discriminating_case: Stale candidate status is flagged; legitimate template fields and historical attribution are not silently deleted.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Declared member/path/JSON checks
items.agreed_scope: Parse all declared JSON, validate admitted member/path kinds, and detect unresolved references. Apply selected whitespace policy separately.
items.scope_limits: Donor checks is_file before is_symlink, so its all-symlinks claim is too broad. Define treatment of broken and directory symlinks explicitly. Whitespace is not semantic qualification; scope excludes deferred representation products.
items.discriminating_case: Malformed JSON, unresolved reference, forbidden file link, broken link and directory link receive the declared handling.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Authenticate helper closure before execution
items.agreed_scope: Use a pinned trusted launcher or authenticated frozen snapshot to verify the selected helper closure before imports/execution.
items.scope_limits: RC9 package.py imports context/build_interpretation before its helper authentication. The donor library loader authenticates first, but the claimed whole bootstrap guarantee is not established. Adapt the guarantee rather than copy the implementation claim.
items.discriminating_case: A modified helper cannot execute before its mismatch is detected; pin the launcher and expected input manifest too.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Retired-owner reference lint
items.agreed_scope: Report Claude-specific retired-owner phrases for review, distinguishing live normative references from intended history.
items.scope_limits: Advisory only: a lexical match is not automatic semantic failure or rewrite authority. Donor ownership_signals collects matches, but the current check_package receipt omits that collection; the adapted lint must expose its findings. Agreement is with the proposed advisory behavior, not the claim that current RC9 already reports it.
items.discriminating_case: Stale live route is reported; quoted predecessor name remains identified as history.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Structured non-body source coverage
items.agreed_scope: Extend the machine conservation account to the exact historical non-body population with scope and disposition preserved.
items.scope_limits: 705 source identities; exact source records preserved; effective dispositions and acceptance pending. Fifteen synthetic predecessor clause extents remain unresolved.
items.discriminating_case: All selected members are accounted for; excluded delivery does not manufacture nonapplicability or acceptance.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Structured successor relations
items.agreed_scope: Record changed meaning, predecessor identity, replacement loci, standing, owner-decision reference, remaining condition and dependencies, retaining original prose/evidence.
items.scope_limits: 705 source identities; exact source records preserved; effective dispositions and acceptance pending. Fifteen synthetic predecessor clause extents remain unresolved.
items.discriminating_case: Each changed claim has a receiving-line-specific relation; pending owner decisions remain pending.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Executive stop and bounded attention
items.agreed_scope: Add applicable stop retaining open obligations to the Executive loop; distinguish loop termination from Product success; acquire only the material portion of durable frontier/results.
items.scope_limits: The stop rule changes meaning. Four further complete-Product-view passages remain unchanged pending owner reach decision. Consumer propagation follows that decision.
items.discriminating_case: Capability exhaustion permits truthful stop with open obligations; closed falsification does not satisfy the Product.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: World Model append-only rationale
items.agreed_scope: Move append-only ledger choice into the added-policy explanation at WORLD_MODEL line178. Preserve the existing operational obligation, entity-cut admissibility and candidate Markov status.
items.discriminating_case: Authenticated historical snapshots can preserve provenance without entailing a particular append-only ledger mechanism; selected profile law still requires its chosen mechanism.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Canonical standards-manifest digest
items.agreed_scope: Fix canonical member-set digest construction and verify actual materialization. Complete identity alone can faithfully pin an incompatible digest. Reuse prior reproduced counterexample because the generator is unchanged.
items.discriminating_case: Namespace/subtree normalization alone still fails; canonical root-prefixed digest plus normalization passes the actual verifier.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Starter binding and bounded acquisition fields
items.agreed_scope: Project the existing computational/execution binding into tenant design starter; add current authoritative-input acquisition and sufficient bounded Product view to frame-basis starter. Preserve base optional Executive/decision-owner guards.
items.scope_limits: Optional-profile guards retained. Current-input and bounded-attention fields refer to the selected owner; A1 propagation remains pending.
items.discriminating_case: Software, human and mixed examples supply both bindings; the template cannot require an unbounded Product context or an unadopted Executive.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

items.title: Plugin selected-basis resolution and identity guidance
items.agreed_scope: Add concrete selected-basis member/anchor resolution and inventory checks, additive owner/task refresh routes, and explicit installed-plugin identity limits. Keep base workflows and actual filenames.
items.scope_limits: Selected-basis owner/task routes are additive. Plugin code/hash identity is separate from semantic fidelity and host activation. No a_c route.
items.discriminating_case: Plugin location/current directory cannot select authority; a missing member cannot fall back to a newer checkout; host install success alone cannot establish matching bytes.
items.agreement: proposal scope agreed; not replacement acceptance

additional_binding_exclusions: No donor result/performance or expanded Judgment schema
No donor effect enum/join or fixed conjunction precedence
No donor frame files or distributed reference-only import architecture
No interpretation, representation, authority-compression delivery or wholesale reconstruction suite
standing: Construction record. Proposal agreement, prepared text, mechanical evidence and acceptance are separate. No whole-method qualification or release is claimed.
